246848|93d3f9d1.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|93d3f9d1.text: Greetings, $N. Welcome to the kingdom of Dalaran.  There are restrictions in place while the city remains under construction. If you have important matters that must be presented to the Kirin Tor, you may speak with Arcanist Ginsberg in the overlook to the east.

246848|ae06472b.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|ae06472b.text:
It is still under construction and only a short walk up the northeast road. The Alterac mountains have brought unneeded attention from some wild creatures and our recent interest in Silverpine Forest has kept our patrols quite busy.

Some small rumors have even spread about a juvenile drake soaring over the mountains with a full eye.

257087|424bc3ca.name: Gretchen Mayberry
257087|424bc3ca.text: Need a lift? Our gryphons are always ready to take to the skies.

257558|f35dbc79.name: Demar Brant
257558|f35dbc79.text:
Ah, it's been some time since we've had adventurers roam these halls. Welcome to Farholde Keep. Enjoy these comforts while you can. I'm sure you've seen the conditions we're forced to keep.

It seems every day we lose more of our home to the ever-growing infestation of Horde mongrels and Light-forsaken Twilight's Hammer cultists. With those cowards in Stormwind hiding behind their walls, we are forced to bring order to these beasts ourselves.

Perhaps you'd like to put some of those $c talents to use?

257591|3e0f5f68.name: Ashe Amberhall
257591|3e0f5f68.text:
When these lands fell to the orcish Horde during the First War, the bulk of the Alliance military moved on to other concerns. They believed the land lost, and that the war efforts were better spent on the home front.

We agree. But the Riverglades are our home, $N. Without aid from the rest of the army, the cavalry men and women of Farholde mounted a bold campaign to retake our lands. Under the command of Demar, we know that someday these lands will belong to us once again. 

This is not just a battle for control, $N. This is a war for our birthright.

257591|a0cd4ece.name: Ashe Amberhall
257591|a0cd4ece.text: Greetings, $c. As advisor to Demar, I would be happy to answer any questions you have about Farholde Keep.

257595|4a0923b3.name: Barracks Master Harlan
257595|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

257595|c80041d2.name: Barracks Master Harlan
257595|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

261485|8137ab65.name: Theramore Guard
261485|8137ab65.text: <The Theramore Marine stands guard in stoic silence.>

272646|e1187d15.name: Miranda Turner
272646|e1187d15.text: Can I help you find something?

274781|3804779b.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

275243|13191e97.name: Teller Gee
275243|13191e97.text: Apologies, madam. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

464|8234ebcf.name: Guard Parker
464|8234ebcf.text: Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...

6299|ec31d7b3.name: Delfrum Flintbeard
6299|ec31d7b3.text: Well my friend, ye have more skill than I do. Why don't ye go find me old friend Rotgath Stonebeard. He stayed in Ironforge when I left to join Jaina's army. I'm sure he'll be able ta teach ye somethin, or at least know someone who can. If he's still around, I'm sure he'll be at The Great Forge.

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1008-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-progress.text: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, $N.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
1008-progress.title: The Zoram Strand

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

123-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
123-progress.text:
What?!?  We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

Let me see that note you have...
123-progress.title: The Collector

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

1579-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1579-progress.text: Did you find my gaffer jacks, $N?  Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!
1579-progress.title: Gaffer Jacks

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

3102-progress.name: Jorik Kerridan
3102-progress.text:
You made it here in one piece, and it doesn't look like too many people saw you. Good enough for me. I don't like to have much attention drawn to me back here... nice and quiet. I'm sure you can understand.

Have any trouble yet? I'm glad to hear not. That'll change soon enough.
3102-progress.title: Encrypted Letter

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

91723-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-complete.text: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
91723-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-accept.text:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.
This is most frustrating, $N. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-complete.text: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.
91724-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91725-complete.name: Blixie Fitzwink
91725-complete.text: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
91725-complete.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732-complete.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-complete.text: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
91732-complete.title: Good Steel

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91743-complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743-complete.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91751-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-complete.text: Excellent work collecting these pelts, $c. You have a real talent for hunting.
91751-complete.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91751-progress.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-progress.text: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
91751-progress.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

91777-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
91777-accept.text:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777-accept.title: Rare Books

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92415-accept.name: Unknown
92415-accept.text: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

92415-complete.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-complete.text:
Heartweaver? Heartweaver...

Oh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing.

He was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.
92415-complete.title: Remember That I Love You

92415-progress.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
92415-progress.text: What is it, $N? What are you looking for?
92415-progress.title: Remember That I Love You

95161-accept.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
95161-accept.text:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

95161-complete.name: Avette Fellwood
95161-complete.text:
Oh no...

It's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain.

Don't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.
95161-complete.title: Remember That I Love You

95195-accept.name: Unknown
95195-accept.text: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195-accept.title: Bloodied Insignia

95195-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-complete.text:
Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves.

Your duty to Stormwind is commended, $N. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
95195-complete.title: Bloodied Insignia

95195-progress.name: General Marcus Jonathan
95195-progress.text: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, $N. What is it?
95195-progress.title: Bloodied Insignia

95250-accept.name: Unknown
95250-accept.text:
What do you want, $r? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250-accept.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust a filthy lesser breed like you. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: You're still alive? Hmmph. Well, what is it? Have you found my lord yet?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

96390-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-accept.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390-accept.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. How's about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96627-complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627-complete.title: The Adventurer

97914-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
97914-accept.text:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914-accept.title: Expanding Horizons

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97920-complete.name: Lee Brown
97920-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97920-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97922-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97922-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97922-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97922-complete.name: Adele Fielder
97922-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97922-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97924-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97924-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97924-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97924-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
97924-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-complete.text:
It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her descent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025-complete.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

983-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98319-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-accept.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a fellow blacksmith who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lass? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-complete.text:
Quite the armful you have.

While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.
98407-complete.title: Show of Force

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98423-accept.name: Unknown
98423-accept.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423-accept.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains
